description: Planted bugs in the holdout app (a room-booking site). Same KINDS of bugs as the demo shop, different specifics. It exists to show the agent isn't tuned to the demo shop: prompts and tools are never adjusted against it. Every bug is switched off in the clean build (vite --mode clean, port 5176).

bugs.title: Availability API answers 503
bugs.description: Every room page asks /api/availability for open dates, and the server answers 503 Service Unavailable, so the page shows 'Availability unknown'.
bugs.how_to_detect: A failed request (status 503) to /api/availability on any room page.

bugs.title: Phone field in the booking form has no label
bugs.description: The phone input has a visual caption that isn't connected to it (no <label for>, no aria-label, no placeholder), so screen readers announce an unnamed text field.
bugs.how_to_detect: axe rule 'label' on a room page.

bugs.title: Booking total charges one night whatever the stay length
bugs.description: The price summary shows '3 nights × $120.00' but the total is $120.00: the number of nights is ignored.
bugs.how_to_detect: Pick dates 2+ nights apart and compare the total with nights × nightly rate.

bugs.title: Check-out date before check-in is accepted
bugs.description: The booking form accepts a check-out date earlier than the check-in date and confirms the booking instead of showing an error next to the check-out field.
bugs.how_to_detect: Enter a check-out date before the check-in date and submit: the booking is confirmed.

bugs.title: Double-clicking 'Book now' creates two bookings
bugs.description: The Book now button isn't disabled while the booking is saved, so a double click creates the same booking twice on My bookings.
bugs.how_to_detect: Double-click Book now with valid data, then open My bookings: the booking is listed twice.

bugs.title: Room name runs off the screen on mobile
bugs.description: On a 375 px wide screen the long name of room 3 doesn't wrap and runs out of its box.
bugs.how_to_detect: At a 375 px viewport, the room title's scrollWidth is larger than its clientWidth, or a screenshot shows the clipped title.
